name: plane-fleet
description: Run work from a Plane board with teams of agent roles, one section per kind of work. Engineering: a PM that claims tickets and lands approved PRs, parallel engineers each in its own worktree and environment slot, blind testers that check every PR in the browser and add tests. Core: a planner, a board specialist and a read-only scanner. Roles can also run on other coding CLIs, picked per spawn by task kind and remaining budget.
